description: This source file defines a class 'SystemTargetPlacementStrategy' that specifies a placement strategy used by system targets in the Orleans framework. The class is sealed, derives from 'PlacementStrategy', and provides an instance property along with an override indicating it does not use a grain directory.

classes.name: SystemTargetPlacementStrategy
classes.description: A placement strategy used by system targets in Orleans, indicating no grain directory usage.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: A singleton property providing a shared instance of the strategy.

methods.name: IsUsingGrainDirectory
methods.description: Overrides the base method to indicate this strategy does not use a grain directory.
